text:
jen: quick alert - noticed preview vs final attribution delta for a narrow set of EU tenants after the "route-resolver v2" rollout. preview shows +~3% tokens in the "unattributed" bucket for a short tail.

david: timeline? which roll pushed when?

jen: v2 rolled at 01:45 UTC. it changed when the resolver runs relative to enrich step. preview consumer still reads the pre-enrichment "shadow" topic -> missing route tags for ~5-12s batches. finalizer reads enriched topic so invoices are correct.

nina: any PII or billing risk?

jen: no PII risk. billing finalization unaffected. main risk: console misleads customers and CS gets tickets. saw 4 tickets this morning.

mayer (maya): can you paste a redacted sample?

jen: redacted log line: `evt: e_7f, ts: 7722223101, tenant: eu-rc2, session: s_71, route: null, tokens: 143` then in finalized ledger: `session s_71 -> route: search-dedupe`

metering-bot: scan: 53 preview events with null route_resolution in window 7722223000..7722223200 for EU cluster.

alan: sounds like a topology race. short-term fix: make preview consumer read the enriched topic (config flip) as a canary. low blast radius if we target single partition.

david: UI mitigation in parallel: show a tiny confidence indicator on the invoice-preview card. call it "preview_confidence_score" (low/medium/high) with tooltip: "Preview may be incomplete during routing rollouts - final invoices are authoritative."

nina: ok support copy: "If you see unexpected route attribution in Preview, wait up to 5 minutes for final invoices or contact support w/ invoice-preview id."

jen: starting canary now on one eu partition. sre-bot kicking off deploy.

sre-bot: deploy started -> preview-consumer-read-enriched.canary.eu partition-3 (sha: b7c4).

jen: canary metrics: preview_delta eu dropped from 3.1% -> 0.35% in 6 minutes. posting grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/preview/preview_vs_final?orgId=1&var-region=eu

david: nice. if stable 30m promote region-wide. I'll add preview_confidence_score UI change behind a feature flag and a short tooltip copy.

alan: long-term proposal: either (A) move enrichment to earliest ingest so both preview and final read same stream, or (B) make preview consumer replay finalization logic exactly. also add an "inflight_enrichment" boolean stamp on events that the UI can surface.

maya: action items: jen - run canary & promote; alan - design doc for enrichment placement; david - UI flag + tooltip; nina - support blurb and runbook snippet (reconcile SQL).

mayer (maya) correction: reconcile SQL suggestion: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) as preview_tokens FROM preview WHERE ts >= t0 GROUP BY session_id; JOIN (SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) as final_tokens FROM final WHERE ts >= t0 GROUP BY session_id) USING(session_id) WHERE preview_tokens != final_tokens;`

jen: ticket created: MT-7782 "preview-shadow-topology attribution race" assigned jen/alan/david.

metering-bot: alert fired at 7722223110: preview_vs_final_delta.eu = 2.9% > 1% threshold.

jen: canary stable at 32m. promoting region-wide now and enabling preview_confidence_score=false default until UI flag flips.

david: will ship the UI flag tomorrow morning and keep the small banner until we finish the enrichment placement design.

alan: please add any follow-ups to MT-7782. we should also record this in the routing-rollout postmortem.

nina: I'll update the CS tickets with the canned note and reference to the reconcile query.

jen: closing thread - no invoice issuance impacted. follow-ups on MT-7782. thanks all. :thumbsup:
